epithet.en: The narrator, an orphan boy who comes into mysterious wealth
epithet.da: Fortælleren, en forældreløs dreng der arver en mystisk formue

1.modern-en: Young Pip introduces himself in the village churchyard and encounters a terrifying escaped convict who threatens him and demands food and a file.
1.modern-da: Den unge Pip præsenterer sig selv på landsbyens kirkegård og møder en skræmmende flygtende forbryder, der truer ham og kræver mad og en fil.

2.modern-en: Pip lives under the harsh rule of his older sister Mrs. Joe and the kind blacksmith Joe Gargery; he steals food and a file for the convict.
2.modern-da: Pip lever under sin ældre søsters hårde styre og den venlige smed Joe Gargerys tag; han stjæler mad og en fil til forbryderen.

3.modern-en: Pip creeps across the misty marshes to deliver food to the convict, who eats ravenously and then sends him away.
3.modern-da: Pip sniger sig over de tågede enge for at bringe mad til forbryderen, der spiser graadigt og sender ham af sted.

4.modern-en: Pip fears exposure at Christmas dinner while soldiers unexpectedly arrive at the forge with a broken pair of handcuffs needing repair.
4.modern-da: Pip frygter at blive afsløret ved juleaftensmiddagen, mens soldater uventet ankommer til smedjen med et par håndjern der skal repareres.

5.modern-en: The soldiers hunt the convicts on the marshes; Pip watches as his convict is recaptured but the man gallantly claims he stole the food himself.
5.modern-da: Soldaterne jager forbryderen over engene; Pip ser til mens hans forbryder bliver gengrebet, men manden erklærer ridderligt at han selv stjal maden.

6.modern-en: Pip feels guilty but keeps silent about his theft; he reflects on his affection for Joe and his shame at his situation.
6.modern-da: Pip føler skyld men tier; han reflekterer over sin hengivenhed for Joe og sin skam over sin situation.

7.modern-en: Pip is learning to read at the village school; Joe explains his own illiteracy with dignity, and Pip is told he will visit the wealthy Miss Havisham.
7.modern-da: Pip lærer at læse i landsbyskolens; Joe forklarer sin egen analfabetisme med værdighed, og Pip får besked om at han skal besøge den rige Miss Havisham.

8.modern-en: Pip visits Miss Havisham's decaying mansion Satis House for the first time and meets the beautiful, cold Estella, who mocks his rough manners.
8.modern-da: Pip besøger Miss Havishams forfalden herregård Satis House for første gang og møder den smukke, kolde Estella, der håner hans grove manerer.

9.modern-en: Back home, Pip invents wild stories about Miss Havisham to satisfy Mrs. Joe's curiosity; he confesses the lies to Joe, who consoles him.
9.modern-da: Hjemme igen opfinder Pip vilde historier om Miss Havisham for at tilfredsstille Mrs. Joes nysgerrighed; han bekender løgnene til Joe, der trøster ham.

10.modern-en: Pip seeks extra lessons from Biddy, wanting to better himself; a mysterious stranger at the pub stirs the file and hints at knowing the convict.
10.modern-da: Pip søger ekstraundervisning fra Biddy, for han vil forbedre sig; en mystisk fremmed på kroen rører i filen og antyder kendskab til forbryderen.

11.modern-en: Pip returns to Satis House and is humiliated by Estella; he fights a pale young gentleman in the garden and wins, which delights Estella.
11.modern-da: Pip vender tilbage til Satis House og ydmyges af Estella; han slås med en bleg ung herre i haven og vinder, hvilket glæder Estella.

12.modern-en: Pip visits Miss Havisham regularly over months; she enjoys watching him play cards with Estella and asks what he thinks of her.
12.modern-da: Pip besøger Miss Havisham jævnligt over måneder; hun nyder at se ham spille kort med Estella og spørger hvad han synes om hende.

13.modern-en: Joe accompanies Pip to Satis House; Miss Havisham gives Pip twenty-five pounds to begin his apprenticeship with Joe as a blacksmith.
13.modern-da: Joe følger Pip til Satis House; Miss Havisham giver Pip fem og tyve pund for at begynde hans lærekontrakt hos Joe som smed.

14.modern-en: Pip feels deeply ashamed of his common life at the forge after knowing Estella and the grandeur of Satis House.
14.modern-da: Pip skammer sig dybt over sit jævne liv ved smedjen efter at have lært Estella og Satis Houses pragt at kende.

15.modern-en: Pip visits Satis House hoping to see Estella but finds she is abroad; Miss Havisham is cold; Orlick brawls with Joe and later assaults Mrs. Joe.
15.modern-da: Pip besøger Satis House i håbet om at se Estella, men hun er i udlandet; Miss Havisham er kold; Orlick slås med Joe og overfalder senere Mrs. Joe.

16.modern-en: Mrs. Joe is found savagely beaten and left brain-damaged; suspicion falls on various people, but the weapon is an old leg-iron.
16.modern-da: Mrs. Joe findes brutalt slået ned og efterladt hjerneskade; mistanken retter sig mod forskellige personer, men våbnet er en gammel benring.

17.modern-en: Pip falls into the dull routine of apprentice life; he confides his feelings of love for Estella to Biddy, who gently questions whether Estella is worth it.
17.modern-da: Pip falder ind i lærlingelivets kedelige rutine; han betror Biddy sine følelser for Estella, som forsigtigt stiller spørgsmålstegn ved om Estella er det værd.

18.modern-en: The lawyer Jaggers appears at the forge and announces that Pip has great expectations — a mysterious benefactor will make him a gentleman.
18.modern-da: Advokaten Jaggers viser sig ved smedjen og fortæller at Pip har store forventninger — en mystisk velgører vil gøre ham til en gentleman.

19.modern-en: Pip prepares to leave for London, saying farewell to Joe and Biddy; he visits Miss Havisham who cryptically seems to approve of his departure.
19.modern-da: Pip forbereder sig på at rejse til London og tager afsked med Joe og Biddy; han besøger Miss Havisham der kryptisk synes at bifalde hans afrejse.

20.modern-en: Pip arrives in London for the first time and is overwhelmed; he goes to the offices of Jaggers, the formidable criminal lawyer.
20.modern-da: Pip ankommer til London for første gang og overvældes; han opsøger kontoret til Jaggers, den formidable kriminaladvokat.

21.modern-en: Wemmick escorts Pip through the grim London streets to Barnard's Inn, where he is to lodge with a young man named Herbert Pocket.
21.modern-da: Wemmick eskorterer Pip gennem Londons dystre gader til Barnard's Inn, hvor han skal bo hos en ung mand ved navn Herbert Pocket.

22.modern-en: Pip discovers that Herbert Pocket is the pale young gentleman he fought at Satis House; they immediately become firm friends.
22.modern-da: Pip opdager at Herbert Pocket er den blegfede unge herre han sloges med ved Satis House; de bliver straks gode venner.

23.modern-en: Pip meets the Pocket family and the other young lodgers, including Drummle and Startop; he begins his education as a gentleman.
23.modern-da: Pip møder Pocket-familien og de andre unge logitagere, herunder Drummle og Startop; han begynder sin uddannelse som gentleman.

24.modern-en: Pip begins his studies with Mr. Pocket and visits Jaggers' office, where he witnesses the lawyer's domineering power over criminals and clients alike.
24.modern-da: Pip begynder sine studier hos Mr. Pocket og besøger Jaggers' kontor, hvor han ser advokatens dominerende magt over kriminelle og klienter.

25.modern-en: Pip dines at Jaggers' house and observes his housekeeper Molly, whose scarred wrists fascinate him; Drummle's surly character is apparent.
25.modern-da: Pip spiser til middag hos Jaggers og iagttager hans husholderske Molly, hvis arvæv på håndleddene fascinerer ham; Drummles gnarvorne karakter viser sig.

26.modern-en: Pip visits Wemmick's eccentric 'castle' home in Walworth and meets the Aged Parent; Wemmick advises Pip not to lend money to Herbert.
26.modern-da: Pip besøger Wemmicks excentriske 'slotshjem' i Walworth og møder den Gamle Forælder; Wemmick råder Pip til ikke at låne penge til Herbert.

27.modern-en: Joe visits Pip in London; the meeting is awkward — Joe is out of place in the city — but Joe bears a message that Estella has returned to Satis House.
27.modern-da: Joe besøger Pip i London; mødet er akavet — Joe er fremmed i byen — men Joe bringer et budskab om at Estella er vendt tilbage til Satis House.

28.modern-en: Pip travels home ostensibly to see Miss Havisham but really to see Estella; in the coach he overhears two convicts, one of whom is Magwitch's agent.
28.modern-da: Pip rejser hjem angiveligt for at se Miss Havisham men egentlig for at se Estella; i kalechen overhører han to forbrydere, hvoraf den ene er Magwitchs agent.

29.modern-en: Pip sees Estella at Satis House; she is more beautiful than ever and he is deeply in love; he begins to believe Miss Havisham intends Estella for him.
29.modern-da: Pip ser Estella i Satis House; hun er smukkere end nogensinde og han er dybt forelsket; han begynder at tro at Miss Havisham har tiltænkt Estella til ham.

30.modern-en: Pip complains to Jaggers about Orlick being hired at Satis House; Jaggers dismisses Orlick, which will breed enmity.
30.modern-da: Pip klager til Jaggers over at Orlick er ansat i Satis House; Jaggers afskediger Orlick, hvilket vil avle fjendskab.

31.modern-en: Pip and Herbert attend Mr. Wopsle's disastrous performance of Hamlet; it provides comic relief as their lives grow more complicated.
31.modern-da: Pip og Herbert overværer Mr. Wopsles katastrofale opsætning af Hamlet; det giver komisk afveksling efterhånden som deres liv bliver mere komplekst.

32.modern-en: Pip receives a note that Estella is coming to London; Wemmick takes him on a grim tour of Newgate Prison while they wait for her coach.
32.modern-da: Pip modtager en besked om at Estella kommer til London; Wemmick tager ham med på en dyster tur til Newgate-fængslet mens de venter på hendes diligence.

33.modern-en: Estella arrives in London and Pip escorts her; she tells him coldly that she has no heart, yet his feelings only deepen.
33.modern-da: Estella ankommer til London og Pip eskorterer hende; hun fortæller ham koldt at hun ikke har noget hjerte, og alligevel bliver hans følelser dybere.

34.modern-en: Pip and Herbert reflect on their mounting debts; Pip feels his idle life is corrupting him and wasting his potential.
34.modern-da: Pip og Herbert overvejer deres voksende gæld; Pip føler at hans dovne liv korrumperer ham og spilder hans potentiale.

35.modern-en: Mrs. Joe dies; Pip returns for the funeral and finds Biddy has been nursing her patiently; Pip promises to visit Joe more often but doubts he will.
35.modern-da: Mrs. Joe dør; Pip vender tilbage til begravelsen og finder at Biddy har plejet hende tålmodigt; Pip lover at besøge Joe oftere men tvivler på at han vil.

36.modern-en: Pip turns twenty-one; Jaggers gives him five hundred pounds a year but refuses to reveal the identity of his benefactor.
36.modern-da: Pip fylder enogtyvety; Jaggers giver ham fem hundrede pund om året men nægter at afsløre velgørerens identitet.

37.modern-en: Pip secretly arranges through Wemmick to set Herbert up as a partner in a shipping firm, anonymously funding his friend's future.
37.modern-da: Pip arrangerer hemmeligt via Wemmick at sætte Herbert op som kompagnon i et skibsrederi og finansierer anonymt sin vens fremtid.

38.modern-en: Estella is staying at Richmond; Pip is tormented by jealousy as she flirts with Drummle; Miss Havisham and Estella have a bitter argument.
38.modern-da: Estella bor i Richmond; Pip plages af jalousi mens hun flirter med Drummle; Miss Havisham og Estella har et bittert skænderi.

39.modern-en: On a stormy night, Pip's mysterious benefactor arrives — it is Magwitch the convict, who reveals he made his fortune in Australia for Pip's sake.
39.modern-da: På en stormfuld nat ankommer Pips mystiske velgører — det er Magwitch forbryderen, der afslører at han har gjort sin formue i Australien for Pips skyld.

40.modern-en: Pip is horrified that his benefactor is a transported convict, not the genteel Miss Havisham; he conceals Magwitch and tries to process the shock.
40.modern-da: Pip er forfærdet over at hans velgører er en deporteret forbryder og ikke den fornemme Miss Havisham; han skjuler Magwitch og forsøger at fordøje chokket.

41.modern-en: Pip tells Herbert the truth about Magwitch; Herbert loyally promises to help; together they learn Magwitch faces death if caught in England.
41.modern-da: Pip fortæller Herbert sandheden om Magwitch; Herbert lover loyalt at hjælpe; sammen lærer de at Magwitch risikerer dødsstraf hvis han fanges i England.

42.modern-en: Magwitch tells his life story — a lifetime of poverty, crime, and imprisonment — and reveals his enemy was the villain Compeyson.
42.modern-da: Magwitch fortæller sin livshistorie — et liv i fattigdom, kriminalitet og fængsling — og afslører at hans fjende var skurken Compeyson.

43.modern-en: Pip confronts Drummle at an inn and feels unable to cut ties with Estella despite everything; he decides to visit her one last time.
43.modern-da: Pip konfronterer Drummle på et værtshus og føler sig ude af stand til at afskære forbindelsen til Estella på trods af alt; han beslutter at besøge hende en sidste gang.

44.modern-en: Pip tells Estella he loves her; she says she is marrying Drummle; he then confronts Miss Havisham about using him to torment men.
44.modern-da: Pip fortæller Estella at han elsker hende; hun siger hun gifter sig med Drummle; han konfronterer derefter Miss Havisham med at have brugt ham til at pine mænd.

45.modern-en: Pip finds a warning note from Wemmick and spends a wretched night in a hotel, fearing for Magwitch's safety.
45.modern-da: Pip finder en advarselsseddel fra Wemmick og tilbringer en elendig nat på et hotel, i frygt for Magwitchs sikkerhed.

46.modern-en: Pip visits the riverside house where Magwitch is hidden; he rows the river regularly to prepare for their eventual escape by boat.
46.modern-da: Pip besøger flodhuset hvor Magwitch er skjult; han ror på floden regelmæssigt for at forberede deres eventuelle flugt med båd.

47.modern-en: Weeks pass in anxious waiting; Pip attends another of Wopsle's plays and is startled to realize Compeyson was sitting behind him.
47.modern-da: Uger går i angstfuld venten; Pip overværer endnu et af Wopsles skuespil og forfærdes over at opdage at Compeyson sad bag ham.

48.modern-en: Pip sees Molly the housekeeper and suddenly recognizes her resemblance to Estella; he confirms with Jaggers and Herbert that Estella is Molly's daughter.
48.modern-da: Pip ser husholderske Molly og genkender pludselig hendes lighed med Estella; han bekræfter med Jaggers og Herbert at Estella er Mollys datter.

49.modern-en: Pip visits Miss Havisham, who regrets her cruelty; she agrees to fund Herbert's business; she accidentally catches fire and Pip saves her, burning himself.
49.modern-da: Pip besøger Miss Havisham, der fortryder sin grusomhed; hun samtykker i at finansiere Herberts forretning; hun antændes ved et uheld og Pip redder hende, men brænder sig selv.

50.modern-en: Pip recovers from his burns; Herbert reveals Magwitch told him that his wife was Molly and his lost daughter is now a lady — confirming Estella's parentage.
50.modern-da: Pip kommer sig over sine forbrændinger; Herbert afslører at Magwitch har fortalt ham at hans kone var Molly og hans fortabte datter nu er en dame — hvilket bekræfter Estellas herkomst.

51.modern-en: Pip presses Jaggers to confirm Estella's true identity; Jaggers makes an extraordinary admission that he placed the baby with Miss Havisham to save her.
51.modern-da: Pip presser Jaggers til at bekræfte Estellas sande identitet; Jaggers indrømmer ekstraordinært at han placerede barnet hos Miss Havisham for at redde hende.

52.modern-en: Pip completes arrangements to set Herbert up in business; he receives a cryptic note luring him to the marshes alone.
52.modern-da: Pip fuldfører arrangementerne for at sætte Herbert i gang med forretningen; han modtager en kryptisk seddel der lokker ham til engene alene.

53.modern-en: Orlick has lured Pip to the sluice house on the marshes to kill him; Herbert and Startop arrive just in time to rescue Pip.
53.modern-da: Orlick har lokket Pip til sluse-huset på engene for at dræbe ham; Herbert og Startop ankommer i tide til at redde Pip.

54.modern-en: Pip and Herbert attempt to row Magwitch to a steamer and out of England; they are intercepted by a police galley and Magwitch is arrested.
54.modern-da: Pip og Herbert forsøger at ro Magwitch til en dampbåd og ud af England; de standses af en politibåd og Magwitch arresteres.

55.modern-en: Magwitch is in prison awaiting trial; Compeyson is dead; Herbert prepares to leave for Cairo to run his new business and invites Pip to join him.
55.modern-da: Magwitch sidder i fængslet og venter på retssagen; Compeyson er død; Herbert forbereder sig på at rejse til Kairo for at drive sin nye forretning og inviterer Pip til at følge med.

56.modern-en: Magwitch is tried, convicted, and sentenced to death; he is dying from his injuries; Pip sits with him at the end, having reconciled himself to love the man.
56.modern-da: Magwitch retsforfølges, dømmes og idømmes dødsstraf; han dør af sine skader; Pip sidder hos ham i hans sidste stund, efter at have forsont sig med at elske manden.

57.modern-en: Pip falls seriously ill from fever; Joe comes to London and nurses him back to health; Pip wakes to find the world feels kinder.
57.modern-da: Pip bliver alvorligt syg af feber; Joe kommer til London og plejer ham rask; Pip vågner og finder at verden føles venligere.

58.modern-en: Pip returns home to propose to Biddy, only to find she has married Joe that same day; he accepts this joyfully and leaves for Egypt to work with Herbert.
58.modern-da: Pip vender hjem for at bede Biddy om hendes hånd, men opdager hun er gift med Joe den dag; han tager dette glædeligt og rejser til Egypten for at arbejde med Herbert.

59.modern-en: Eleven years later, Pip visits Joe and Biddy and meets Joe's young son, also named Pip; walking near Satis House he encounters Estella, widowed and changed.
59.modern-da: Elleve år senere besøger Pip Joe og Biddy og møder Joes lille søn, også kaldt Pip; ved Satis House møder han Estella, der er enke og forandret.

epithet.en: Pip's gentle brother-in-law and blacksmith, a man of simple goodness
epithet.da: Pips milde svoger og smed, et menneske af simpel godhed

1.modern-en: Joe is briefly described as the village blacksmith married to Pip's sister Mrs. Joe.
1.modern-da: Joe beskrives kort som landsbysmed gift med Pips søster Mrs. Joe.

2.modern-en: Joe is kind to Pip at home, covertly slipping him extra food under the table to buffer Mrs. Joe's harshness.
2.modern-da: Joe er venlig mod Pip hjemme og skubber hemmeligt ekstra mad til ham under bordet for at afbøde Mrs. Joes hårde behandling.

3.modern-en: Joe is present at the forge as Pip sneaks out to help the convict.
3.modern-da: Joe er til stede ved smedjen mens Pip sniger sig ud for at hjælpe forbryderen.

4.modern-en: Joe is relegated to the kitchen doorstep during Christmas dinner while Mrs. Joe busies herself entertaining; his good nature shows under pressure.
4.modern-da: Joe relegeres til køkkendørstenen under julefrokost mens Mrs. Joe travlt underholdt gæsterne; hans gode natur viser sig under pres.

5.modern-en: Joe joins the hunt across the marshes; when the convict is caught, Joe says charitably that he would not want to see any poor wretched creature hunted.
5.modern-da: Joe deltager i jagten på engene; da forbryderen fanges, siger Joe velvilligt at han ikke ville ønske at se nogen stakkel jagtet.

6.modern-en: Joe's steady goodness is a silent counterpoint to Pip's guilty conscience about the stolen food.
6.modern-da: Joes stabile godhed er en stille modsætning til Pips skyldbevidste samvittighed om den stjålne mad.

7.modern-en: Joe explains why he never learned to read: he wanted to shield his mother and felt ashamed; his honesty and humility are moving.
7.modern-da: Joe forklarer hvorfor han aldrig lærte at læse: han ville beskytte sin mor og skammede sig; hans ærlighed og ydmyghed er rørende.

8.modern-en: Joe waves Pip off to Miss Havisham's; his warmth is the anchor Pip is about to leave behind.
8.modern-da: Joe vinker Pip af sted til Miss Havisham; hans varme er det anker Pip er ved at forlade.

9.modern-en: Joe gently encourages Pip to be truthful after Pip invents stories about Miss Havisham.
9.modern-da: Joe opfordrer forsigtigt Pip til at være sandfærdig efter Pip opfinder historier om Miss Havisham.

10.modern-en: Joe is briefly present as Pip begins seeking Biddy's tutoring to improve himself.
10.modern-da: Joe er kort til stede mens Pip begynder at søge Biddys undervisning for at forbedre sig.

11.modern-en: Joe is mentioned as Pip returns to Satis House and reflects on the contrast between his forge life and Estella's world.
11.modern-da: Joe nævnes da Pip vender tilbage til Satis House og overvejer kontrasten mellem hans smedjeliv og Estellas verden.

12.modern-en: Joe is part of the domestic background Pip is beginning to feel ashamed of.
12.modern-da: Joe er en del af den hjemlige baggrund som Pip begynder at skamme sig over.

13.modern-en: Joe accompanies Pip to Satis House in his Sunday best; his good-natured awkwardness in the fine setting is touching; he receives Pip's apprenticeship premium.
13.modern-da: Joe følger Pip til Satis House i sit søndagstøj; hans godmodige akavethed i de fine omgivelser er rørende; han modtager Pips lærlingepræmie.

15.modern-en: Orlick picks a fight with Joe; Joe beats him easily but without cruelty; later Joe helps search for Mrs. Joe after her attack.
15.modern-da: Orlick udfordrer Joe til slagsmål; Joe slår ham nemt men uden grusomhed; senere hjælper Joe med at lede efter Mrs. Joe efter overfaldet.

16.modern-en: Joe is devastated by the savage attack on Mrs. Joe and helps nurse her through her injury.
16.modern-da: Joe er knust over det brutale overfald på Mrs. Joe og hjælper med at pleje hende igennem hendes skade.

17.modern-en: Joe and Pip continue their apprenticeship together; Joe represents the honest, unpretentious life Pip is beginning to leave behind.
17.modern-da: Joe og Pip fortsætter deres lærlingeforhold; Joe repræsenterer det ærlige, pretentiøse liv Pip er ved at forlade.

18.modern-en: Joe listens quietly as Jaggers delivers the news of Pip's great expectations; he accepts Pip's departure with dignity and without complaint.
18.modern-da: Joe lytter stille mens Jaggers bringer nyheden om Pips store forventninger; han accepterer Pips afrejse med værdighed og uden klager.

19.modern-en: Joe bids Pip a dignified, warm farewell; he does not ask for anything or show resentment, only love.
19.modern-da: Joe tager en værdig, varm afsked med Pip; han beder ikke om noget eller viser bitterhed, kun kærlighed.

27.modern-en: Joe visits Pip in London; the meeting is painfully awkward as Joe is out of place among the genteel furnishings, yet his message about Estella is delivered faithfully.
27.modern-da: Joe besøger Pip i London; mødet er smertefuldt akavet da Joe er fremmed i de fine omgivelser, men hans besked om Estella leveres trofast.

28.modern-en: Pip passes through town and decides not to stay at Joe's forge, excusing it to himself — revealing his snobbery.
28.modern-da: Pip passerer gennem byen og beslutter ikke at overnatte hos Joe, og undskylder det over for sig selv — hvilket afslører hans snoberi.

35.modern-en: Joe is bereaved at Mrs. Joe's death; his grief is simple and genuine; Pip sees him as older and quieter.
35.modern-da: Joe er sorgramt over Mrs. Joes død; hans sorg er simpel og oprigtig; Pip ser ham som ældre og mere stille.

52.modern-en: Pip thinks of Joe as he prepares for the dangerous escape plan, aware he has neglected him.
52.modern-da: Pip tænker på Joe mens han forbereder den farlige flugtplan, bevidst om at han har forsømt ham.

56.modern-en: Joe is mentioned as Pip sits with the dying Magwitch, reflecting on how far he has come from the forge.
56.modern-da: Joe nævnes da Pip sidder hos den døende Magwitch og reflekterer over hvor langt han er kommet fra smedjen.

57.modern-en: Joe comes to London and nurses the feverish Pip back to health with devoted care; he pays off Pip's debt before quietly departing.
57.modern-da: Joe kommer til London og plejer den feberramte Pip rask med hengiven omsorg; han betaler Pips gæld af før han stille tager af sted.

58.modern-en: Pip returns to find Joe has married Biddy; the reunion is joyful; Joe's lifelong goodness is finally recognized and rewarded.
58.modern-da: Pip vender tilbage og finder at Joe har giftet sig med Biddy; genforeningen er glædelig; Joes livslange godhed anerkendes og belønnes endelig.

59.modern-en: Joe and Biddy are happily married with a young son they have named Pip; Joe has found the contentment he deserved.
59.modern-da: Joe og Biddy er lykkeligt gifte med en lille søn de har opkaldt Pip; Joe har fundet den lykke han fortjente.

epithet.en: Pip's sharp-tongued sister, who raised him 'by hand' with harsh discipline
epithet.da: Pips skarptungede søster, der opfostrede ham 'med hånden' og hård disciplin

1.modern-en: Mrs. Joe is described as Pip's sister who raised him 'by hand' — with frequent physical correction.
1.modern-da: Mrs. Joe beskrives som Pips søster der opfostrede ham 'med hånden' — med hyppig fysisk afstraffelse.

2.modern-en: Mrs. Joe is furious when Pip returns late from the churchyard; she subjects both him and Joe to a tirade and a liberal application of her cane.
2.modern-da: Mrs. Joe er rasende da Pip vender forsinket hjem fra kirkegården; hun underkaster både ham og Joe en tirade og en gavmild brug af sin stok.

4.modern-en: Mrs. Joe hosts Christmas dinner with great self-importance, berating Pip before the guests and serving the pork pie Pip has stolen from.
4.modern-da: Mrs. Joe afholder julefrokost med stor selvhøjtidelighed, skælder Pip ud foran gæsterne og serverer den svinekødspostej Pip har stjålet fra.

5.modern-en: Mrs. Joe is bewildered and flustered by the soldiers' unexpected arrival but quickly reasserts her authority.
5.modern-da: Mrs. Joe er forvirret og forhastet over soldaternes uventede ankomst men genindfanger hurtigt sin autoritet.

6.modern-en: Mrs. Joe's harshness is described as having shaped both Pip's guilt and his deep affection for Joe.
6.modern-da: Mrs. Joes hårdhed beskrives som havende formet både Pips skyld og hans dybe hengivenhed for Joe.

7.modern-en: Mrs. Joe announces that Pip is to visit Miss Havisham, a piece of news she delivers with maximum self-importance.
7.modern-da: Mrs. Joe annoncerer at Pip skal besøge Miss Havisham, en nyhed hun fremsætter med maksimal selvhøjtidelighed.

9.modern-en: Mrs. Joe interrogates Pip aggressively about his visit to Miss Havisham, demanding details and resorting to force when he evades.
9.modern-da: Mrs. Joe afhører Pip aggressivt om hans besøg hos Miss Havisham, kræver detaljer og griber til vold da han undviger.

10.modern-en: Mrs. Joe is pleased when the mysterious stranger at the pub sends a pound, confirming the convict's indirect gratitude to the household.
10.modern-da: Mrs. Joe er glad da den mystiske fremmed på kroen sender et pund, hvilket bekræfter forbrydernes indirekte taknemlighed over for husstanden.

11.modern-en: Mrs. Joe is eager for Pip to continue visiting Miss Havisham, hoping it will bring the family social advancement.
11.modern-da: Mrs. Joe er ivrig efter at Pip fortsætter med at besøge Miss Havisham, i håb om at det vil bringe familien social fremgang.

12.modern-en: Mrs. Joe pesters Pip for news about Miss Havisham's household, always hoping for material benefit.
12.modern-da: Mrs. Joe plager Pip for nyheder om Miss Havishams husstand, altid i håb om materiel fordel.

13.modern-en: Mrs. Joe accompanies Pip and Joe to Satis House; she is fawning toward Uncle Pumblechook who arranged the visit.
13.modern-da: Mrs. Joe ledsager Pip og Joe til Satis House; hun er smigrende over for onkel Pumblechook der arrangerede besøget.

15.modern-en: Mrs. Joe is savagely attacked and left unconscious on the kitchen floor, with a leg-iron as the weapon; she suffers permanent brain damage.
15.modern-da: Mrs. Joe overfaldes brutalt og efterlades bevidstløs på køkkengulvet med en benring som våben; hun lider permanent hjerneskade.

16.modern-en: Mrs. Joe survives but is now childlike and mute, unable to speak coherently; she communicates by drawing on a slate.
16.modern-da: Mrs. Joe overlever men er nu barnagtig og stum, ude af stand til at tale sammenhængende; hun kommunikerer ved at tegne på en tavle.

17.modern-en: Mrs. Joe sits placidly by the fire, a shadow of her former self, with Biddy attending to her needs.
17.modern-da: Mrs. Joe sidder roligt ved ilden, en skygge af sit tidligere jeg, med Biddy der tager sig af hendes behov.

35.modern-en: Mrs. Joe dies quietly; her death ends years of suffering; Pip returns for the funeral and reflects on her hard life.
35.modern-da: Mrs. Joe dør stille; hendes død afslutter mange års lidelse; Pip vender tilbage til begravelsen og reflekterer over hendes hårde liv.

epithet.en: The convict Pip helped as a child, who secretly made Pip a gentleman
epithet.da: Forbryderen Pip hjalp som barn, der hemmeligt gjorde Pip til en gentleman

1.modern-en: A terrifying convict emerges from the churchyard mist and seizes young Pip, demanding food and a file under threat of violence.
1.modern-da: En skræmmende forbryder stiger op af kirkegårdens tåge og griber den unge Pip, og kræver mad og en fil under trussel om vold.

2.modern-en: The convict waits on the marshes for Pip to return with stolen food and a file to cut his leg-iron.
2.modern-da: Forbryderen venter på engene på at Pip vender tilbage med stjålet mad og en fil til at skære hans benring over.

3.modern-en: Pip delivers food and the file to the grateful convict on the frozen marshes.
3.modern-da: Pip leverer mad og filen til den taknemmelige forbryder på de frosne enge.

5.modern-en: The convict is recaptured after fighting his enemy Compeyson in the marsh; he gallantly tells the soldiers that he stole the food himself to protect Pip.
5.modern-da: Forbryderen gengripes efter at have slåedes med sin fjende Compeyson på engen; han fortæller ridderligt soldaterne at han selv stjal maden for at beskytte Pip.

6.modern-en: The convict is taken aboard the prison ship; Pip watches from a distance, never expecting to see him again.
6.modern-da: Forbryderen bringes om bord på fængselsskibet; Pip ser til på afstand, aldrig forventende at se ham igen.

28.modern-en: Pip overhears a convict in the coach who turns out to be Magwitch's old messenger, delivering two one-pound notes — tokens of the man's lasting gratitude.
28.modern-da: Pip overhører en forbryder i diligencen der viser sig at være Magwitchs gamle budbringer, der leverer to en-pundssedler — tegn på mandens vedvarende taknemlighed.

39.modern-en: Magwitch returns from Australia and reveals himself to Pip as his secret benefactor, having made a fortune to create a gentleman out of the boy who helped him.
39.modern-da: Magwitch vender tilbage fra Australien og afslører sig for Pip som hans hemmelige velgører, efter at have tjent en formue for at gøre en gentleman ud af drengen der hjalp ham.

40.modern-en: Magwitch stays hidden in Pip's rooms; Pip struggles to reconcile his revulsion with the man's obvious devotion.
40.modern-da: Magwitch holder sig skjult i Pips lejlighed; Pip kæmper med at forsone sin afsky med mandens åbenlyse hengivenhed.

41.modern-en: Magwitch, Herbert, and Pip discuss the dangerous reality of his situation — he faces death if caught in England.
41.modern-da: Magwitch, Herbert og Pip drøfter den farlige virkelighed i hans situation — han risikerer dødsstraf hvis han fanges i England.

42.modern-en: Magwitch tells his life story: abandoned as a child, a life of crime and prison, and how Compeyson used him and escaped with a lighter sentence.
42.modern-da: Magwitch fortæller sin livshistorie: forladt som barn, et liv med kriminalitet og fængsel, og hvordan Compeyson brugte ham og slap med en lettere dom.

43.modern-en: Magwitch remains hidden while Pip travels to see Estella; his presence haunts every decision Pip makes.
43.modern-da: Magwitch forbliver skjult mens Pip rejser for at se Estella; hans tilstedeværelse hjemsøger enhver beslutning Pip træffer.

45.modern-en: Magwitch is moved to a new hiding place; Pip learns he is being watched by an enemy.
45.modern-da: Magwitch flyttes til et nyt skjulested; Pip lærer at han overvåges af en fjende.

46.modern-en: Magwitch hides at a waterside lodging-house under the alias Provis; Pip visits him regularly and rows the river to prepare their escape route.
46.modern-da: Magwitch gemmer sig på et vandsidet logis under dæknafnet Provis; Pip besøger ham jævnligt og ror på floden for at forberede deres flugtrute.

47.modern-en: Pip sees Compeyson watching at the theater and fears the net is closing on Magwitch.
47.modern-da: Pip ser Compeyson iagttage ved teatret og frygter at nettet lukker sig om Magwitch.

50.modern-en: Through Herbert, Pip learns that Magwitch's wife was Molly and that his daughter — presumed dead — was placed with a wealthy woman by a lawyer.
50.modern-da: Via Herbert lærer Pip at Magwitchs kone var Molly og at hans datter — formodet død — blev placeret hos en rig kvinde af en advokat.

52.modern-en: Pip prepares for Magwitch's escape attempt; the plan is set for the following week.
52.modern-da: Pip forbereder sig på Magwitchs flugtforsøg; planen er sat til den følgende uge.

53.modern-en: Magwitch waits at the riverside while Pip is waylaid by Orlick; the rescue comes just in time.
53.modern-da: Magwitch venter ved flodbredden mens Pip overfaldes af Orlick; redningen kommer i tide.

54.modern-en: During the escape attempt, Magwitch is seized by officers; he fatally wounds Compeyson in the struggle before being pulled aboard.
54.modern-da: Under flugtforsøget gribes Magwitch af betjente; han sårer Compeyson fatalt i kampen inden han trækkes om bord.

55.modern-en: Magwitch is imprisoned; Compeyson is confirmed drowned; Magwitch's transportation sentence carries the death penalty for his return.
55.modern-da: Magwitch er fængslet; Compeyson bekræftes druknet; Magwitchs deporteringsdom medfører dødsstraf for hans hjemkomst.

56.modern-en: Magwitch is dying in prison from his injuries; Pip sits with him daily and tells him before he dies that his daughter is alive and a lady — his one last comfort.
56.modern-da: Magwitch dør i fængslet af sine skader; Pip sidder hos ham dagligt og fortæller ham inden han dør at hans datter er i live og er en dame — hans ene sidste trøst.

epithet.en: A jilted bride frozen in time, who raises Estella to break men's hearts
epithet.da: En forladt brud fruset i tid, der opdrager Estella til at knuse mænds hjerter

7.modern-en: Miss Havisham is introduced as the eccentric, wealthy recluse of Satis House who wants a boy to come and play.
7.modern-da: Miss Havisham introduceres som den excentriske, velhavende eneboer fra Satis House der ønsker en dreng at komme og lege.

8.modern-en: Pip first sees Miss Havisham: a woman in a wedding dress, clocks stopped at twenty to nine, the rotting wedding cake on the table — a woman fixed at the moment she was jilted.
8.modern-da: Pip ser Miss Havisham for første gang: en kvinde i brudesrobe, ure stoppet ti i ni, den rådnende bryllupskage på bordet — en kvinde fastlåst i øjeblikket hun blev forladt.

9.modern-en: Miss Havisham sends Pip away but he imagines her curiosity about his impressions; her strange power over him is already evident.
9.modern-da: Miss Havisham sender Pip af sted men han forestiller sig hendes nysgerrighed om hans indtryk; hendes mystiske magt over ham er allerede tydelig.

10.modern-en: Miss Havisham summons Pip back to Satis House for regular visits.
10.modern-da: Miss Havisham kalder Pip tilbage til Satis House for regelmæssige besøg.

11.modern-en: Miss Havisham watches Pip and Estella play cards; she is clearly using Pip as a tool to train Estella's power over men.
11.modern-da: Miss Havisham ser Pip og Estella spille kort; det er tydeligt at hun bruger Pip som et redskab til at træne Estellas magt over mænd.

12.modern-en: Miss Havisham asks Pip what he thinks of Estella; she takes quiet, manipulative pleasure in his evident infatuation.
12.modern-da: Miss Havisham spørger Pip hvad han synes om Estella; hun nyder stille, manipulerende fornøjelse over hans tydelige forelskelse.

13.modern-en: Miss Havisham pays Joe Pip's premium and releases him from his apprenticeship, acting as if bestowing a great gift.
13.modern-da: Miss Havisham betaler Joe Pips lærlingepræmie og frigiver ham fra hans lærlingekontrakt, som om hun skænker en stor gave.

14.modern-en: Pip continues visiting Miss Havisham; she feeds his shame about his ordinary origins while cultivating his feelings for Estella.
14.modern-da: Pip fortsætter med at besøge Miss Havisham; hun nærer hans skam over hans ordinære oprindelse mens hun dyrker hans følelser for Estella.

15.modern-en: Pip visits and finds Estella is abroad; Miss Havisham dismisses him coldly.
15.modern-da: Pip besøger og finder at Estella er i udlandet; Miss Havisham afviser ham koldt.

17.modern-en: Pip makes his regular birthday visit to Miss Havisham; she is unchanged — still entombed in her stopped time.
17.modern-da: Pip aflægger sit regelmæssige fødselsdagsbesøg hos Miss Havisham; hun er uændret — stadig indmuret i sin stoppede tid.

18.modern-en: Pip's great expectations are revealed; though Pip believes Miss Havisham is his benefactor, she does nothing to correct this impression.
18.modern-da: Pips store forventninger afsløres; selvom Pip tror Miss Havisham er hans velgører, gør hun intet for at rette dette indtryk.

19.modern-en: Pip visits Miss Havisham before departing for London; she seems to enjoy his delusion that she is his benefactor.
19.modern-da: Pip besøger Miss Havisham inden han rejser til London; hun synes at nyde hans vildfarelse om at hun er hans velgører.

25.modern-en: Miss Havisham is mentioned as Pip considers whether she intends him for Estella.
25.modern-da: Miss Havisham nævnes da Pip overvejer om hun har tiltænkt ham Estella.

29.modern-en: Miss Havisham watches Estella and Pip with cold, hungry satisfaction; she urges Pip to love Estella — though Pip misreads this as blessing his suit.
29.modern-da: Miss Havisham iagttager Estella og Pip med kold, sulten tilfredsstillelse; hun opfordrer Pip til at elske Estella — selvom Pip fejlfortolker dette som en velsignelse af hans frieri.

32.modern-en: Miss Havisham is mentioned as the supposed source of Pip's fortune as he awaits Estella in London.
32.modern-da: Miss Havisham nævnes som den formodede kilde til Pips formue mens han venter på Estella i London.

33.modern-en: Estella conveys Miss Havisham's influence is behind her journey to London society; Miss Havisham is pulling the strings.
33.modern-da: Estella formidler at Miss Havishams indflydelse ligger bag hendes rejse til Londons selskabsliv; Miss Havisham trækker i trådene.

38.modern-en: Miss Havisham and Estella have a raw argument; Estella tells her coldly that she cannot love — Miss Havisham created her that way — and Miss Havisham weeps in despair.
38.modern-da: Miss Havisham og Estella har et råt skænderi; Estella fortæller hende koldt at hun ikke kan elske — Miss Havisham skabte hende sådan — og Miss Havisham græder i fortvivlelse.

44.modern-en: Pip confronts Miss Havisham about her deception; she admits guilt and asks what she can do to make amends, agreeing to help Herbert.
44.modern-da: Pip konfronterer Miss Havisham om hendes bedrag; hun indrømmer skyld og spørger hvad hun kan gøre for at gøre godt, og samtykker i at hjælpe Herbert.

49.modern-en: Miss Havisham begs Pip's forgiveness for the damage she caused; her rotting wedding dress catches fire and Pip smothers the flames, but she is badly burned.
49.modern-da: Miss Havisham beder Pip om tilgivelse for den skade hun har forvoldt; hendes rådnende brudekjole antændes og Pip kvæler flammerne, men hun er alvorligt brændt.

50.modern-en: Miss Havisham dies from her burns; her death closes the chapter of Satis House's frozen grief.
50.modern-da: Miss Havisham dør af sine forbrændinger; hendes død lukker kapitlet om Satis Houses frosne sorg.

epithet.en: The cold, beautiful ward of Miss Havisham, raised to break hearts
epithet.da: Miss Havishams kolde, smukke myndling, opdraget til at knuse hjerter

8.modern-en: Pip meets Estella at Satis House; she is beautiful and contemptuous, mocking his coarse hands and thick boots.
8.modern-da: Pip møder Estella i Satis House; hun er smuk og foragtelig, der håner hans grove hænder og tykke støvler.

9.modern-en: Pip is haunted by Estella's contempt; he cries secretly and begins to feel ashamed of his ordinary life.
9.modern-da: Pip hjemsøges af Estellas foragt; han græder i hemmelighed og begynder at skamme sig over sit ordinære liv.

11.modern-en: Estella locks Pip in the garden with the pale young gentleman and watches the fight with detached amusement; she lets Pip kiss her cheek as a reward.
11.modern-da: Estella låser Pip inde i haven med den blegfede unge herre og ser slåskampen med distanceret fornøjelse; hun lader Pip kysse hende på kinden som belønning.

12.modern-en: Estella plays cards with Pip under Miss Havisham's watchful eye; she is teaching herself to be unfeeling.
12.modern-da: Estella spiller kort med Pip under Miss Havishams vågne øje; hun lærer sig selv at være følelsesløs.

13.modern-en: Estella is present but distant as Miss Havisham pays for Pip's apprenticeship; she shows no emotion.
13.modern-da: Estella er til stede men distanceret da Miss Havisham betaler for Pips lærlingekontrakt; hun viser ingen følelser.

14.modern-en: Estella's coldness is already reshaping Pip's values and self-image.
14.modern-da: Estellas kulde former allerede Pips værdier og selvbillede.

15.modern-en: Estella is abroad; her absence makes Pip's visit to Satis House pointless and bleak.
15.modern-da: Estella er i udlandet; hendes fravær gør Pips besøg i Satis House meningsløst og dystert.

17.modern-en: Pip confesses his hopeless love for Estella to Biddy; Estella represents everything he aspires to yet cannot have.
17.modern-da: Pip bekender sin håbløse kærlighed til Estella over for Biddy; Estella repræsenterer alt han stræber efter men ikke kan få.

18.modern-en: Estella is the unnamed but powerful motivation behind Pip's desire to become a gentleman.
18.modern-da: Estella er den unavngivne men kraftfulde motivation bag Pips ønske om at blive en gentleman.

19.modern-en: Pip hopes that his new wealth and gentlemanly status will eventually win Estella.
19.modern-da: Pip håber at hans nye rigdom og gentlemanstatus til sidst vil vinde Estella.

22.modern-en: Herbert tells Pip about Estella's origins and Miss Havisham's past — how she was jilted and adopted Estella to take revenge on men.
22.modern-da: Herbert fortæller Pip om Estellas oprindelse og Miss Havishams fortid — hvordan hun blev forladt og adopterede Estella for at tage hævn på mænd.

25.modern-en: Pip thinks constantly of Estella and watches for any sign that Miss Havisham intends her for him.
25.modern-da: Pip tænker konstant på Estella og holder øje med ethvert tegn på at Miss Havisham har tiltænkt hende til ham.

29.modern-en: Estella receives Pip coldly but beautifully at Satis House; she warns him that she has no heart, yet he refuses to believe her.
29.modern-da: Estella modtager Pip koldt men smukt i Satis House; hun advarer ham om at hun ikke har noget hjerte, men han nægter at tro hende.

32.modern-en: Estella sends a note that she is coming to London; Pip is overwhelmed with anticipation.
32.modern-da: Estella sender en besked om at hun kommer til London; Pip overvældes af forventning.

33.modern-en: Estella arrives in London; she is coolly gracious to Pip, treating him as a companion rather than a suitor.
33.modern-da: Estella ankommer til London; hun er køligt nådig mod Pip og behandler ham som en følgesvend snarere end en bejler.

38.modern-en: Estella flirts with Drummle to Pip's anguish; she has a heated confrontation with Miss Havisham, accusing her of creating a loveless creature.
38.modern-da: Estella flirter med Drummle til Pips smerte; hun har en ophidset konfrontation med Miss Havisham og beskylder hende for at have skabt en kærlighedsløs skabning.

44.modern-en: Estella tells Pip she is marrying Drummle — not because she loves him, but because she has no heart to give anyone.
44.modern-da: Estella fortæller Pip at hun gifter sig med Drummle — ikke fordi hun elsker ham, men fordi hun ikke har noget hjerte at give nogen.

48.modern-en: Pip suddenly recognizes Estella's likeness in Molly the housekeeper and pieces together her true parentage.
48.modern-da: Pip genkender pludselig Estellas lighed i husholderske Molly og sætter hendes sande herkomst sammen.

59.modern-en: Years later, Pip finds Estella widowed and softened by suffering; their final meeting suggests the possibility of reconciliation.
59.modern-da: År senere finder Pip Estella enkejort og blødgjort af lidelse; deres sidste møde antyder muligheden for forsoning.

epithet.en: Pip's cheerful, loyal friend and flatmate in London
epithet.da: Pips muntre, loyale ven og bofælle i London

11.modern-en: The pale young gentleman fights Pip in Miss Havisham's garden — and loses; his sporting good humor afterward is the seed of their friendship.
11.modern-da: Den blegfede unge herre slås med Pip i Miss Havishams have — og taber; hans sportslige godt humør bagefter er spiret til deres venskab.

22.modern-en: Herbert and Pip are reunited in London; Herbert cheerfully recalls being beaten and immediately makes Pip welcome, giving him the nickname Handel.
22.modern-da: Herbert og Pip genforenes i London; Herbert erindrer muntert at have fået tæsk og byder straks Pip velkommen, og giver ham øgenavnet Handel.

23.modern-en: Herbert politely corrects Pip's table manners and explains his own modest but cheerful hopes of making his fortune in trade.
23.modern-da: Herbert retter høfligt Pips bordmanerer og forklarer sine egne beskedne men muntre håb om at gøre sin formue i handel.

24.modern-en: Herbert and Pip settle into life at Barnard's Inn, their debts already beginning to accumulate.
24.modern-da: Herbert og Pip slår sig til i Barnard's Inn, deres gæld allerede begyndende at vokse.

25.modern-en: Herbert attends Jaggers' dinner with Pip; he is observant of their host's domineering manner.
25.modern-da: Herbert deltager i Jaggers' middag med Pip; han er observant over for deres verts dominerende måde.

26.modern-en: Herbert visits Wemmick's castle with Pip; they are both charmed by the eccentric domestic setup.
26.modern-da: Herbert besøger Wemmicks slot med Pip; de er begge fascinerede af den excentriske hjemlige opsætning.

27.modern-en: Herbert tries to smooth the awkward visit from Joe Gargery, good-naturedly stepping aside so Pip and Joe can talk.
27.modern-da: Herbert forsøger at udglatte Joes akavet besøg og træder godt naturligt til side så Pip og Joe kan tale.

28.modern-en: Herbert is mentioned as Pip prepares to travel home; Herbert's cheerful common sense grounds Pip.
28.modern-da: Herbert nævnes da Pip forbereder sig på at rejse hjem; Herberts muntre sunde fornuft forankrer Pip.

29.modern-en: Herbert is part of the London life Pip briefly leaves behind when visiting Satis House.
29.modern-da: Herbert er en del af Londons liv Pip kort forlader da han besøger Satis House.

30.modern-en: Herbert hears about Pip's confrontation with Orlick and his confused feelings about Estella.
30.modern-da: Herbert hører om Pips konfrontation med Orlick og hans forvirrede følelser for Estella.

31.modern-en: Herbert accompanies Pip to Wopsle's disastrous production of Hamlet; they enjoy the comedy together.
31.modern-da: Herbert følger Pip til Wopsles katastrofale opsætning af Hamlet; de nyder komedien sammen.

32.modern-en: Herbert is sympathetic as Pip anxiously awaits Estella's arrival in London.
32.modern-da: Herbert er sympatisk da Pip angstfuldt venter på Estellas ankomst til London.

33.modern-en: Herbert escorts Estella with Pip and tries diplomatically to ease the emotional tension.
33.modern-da: Herbert eskorterer Estella med Pip og forsøger diplomatisk at lette den emotionelle spænding.

34.modern-en: Herbert and Pip review their debts together and make increasingly ineffective plans to address them.
34.modern-da: Herbert og Pip gennemgår deres gæld sammen og laver stadigt mere ineffektive planer for at adressere dem.

36.modern-en: Herbert accepts Pip's secret gift of a business partnership with genuine gratitude, unaware of its source.
36.modern-da: Herbert accepterer Pips hemmelige gave om et forretningskompagniskab med oprigtig taknemlighed, uvidende om dens oprindelse.

37.modern-en: Herbert's future in Clarriker's business is secured; Pip feels it is the one good thing he has done with his fortune.
37.modern-da: Herberts fremtid i Clarikers forretning er sikret; Pip føler at det er den eneste gode ting han har gjort med sin formue.

38.modern-en: Herbert is troubled by Pip's obsession with Estella and warns him gently that Drummle is dangerous.
38.modern-da: Herbert er bekymret over Pips besættelse af Estella og advarer ham forsigtigt om at Drummle er farlig.

39.modern-en: Herbert is alarmed by Magwitch's arrival; he stays steady and calm to help Pip through the shock.
39.modern-da: Herbert er forfærdet over Magwitchs ankomst; han forbliver stabil og rolig for at hjælpe Pip igennem chokket.

40.modern-en: Herbert helps keep Magwitch hidden and manages the logistics of his concealment.
40.modern-da: Herbert hjælper med at holde Magwitch skjult og håndterer logistikken i hans skjul.

41.modern-en: Herbert learns the full story of Pip's benefactor; he immediately commits to helping plan an escape from England.
41.modern-da: Herbert lærer hele historien om Pips velgører; han forpligter sig straks til at hjælpe med at planlægge en flugt fra England.

45.modern-en: Herbert manages Magwitch's situation while Pip is away; his steadiness is essential.
45.modern-da: Herbert håndterer Magwitchs situation mens Pip er væk; hans stabilitet er afgørende.

46.modern-en: Herbert plays his part in the escape plan, rowing practice and keeping watch.
46.modern-da: Herbert spiller sin rolle i flugtplanen, øver roning og holder vagt.

50.modern-en: Herbert tells Pip what Magwitch told him about his wife Molly and his lost daughter — crucial information revealing Estella's true parentage.
50.modern-da: Herbert fortæller Pip hvad Magwitch fortalte ham om sin kone Molly og sin fortabte datter — afgørende information der afslører Estellas sande herkomst.

52.modern-en: Herbert prepares for the boat escape; he also reveals he is engaged to Clara and will soon move to Cairo for business.
52.modern-da: Herbert forbereder sig på bådflugt; han afslører også at han er forlovet med Clara og snart flytter til Kairo for sin forretning.

53.modern-en: Herbert rescues Pip from Orlick's trap on the marshes with Startop's help.
53.modern-da: Herbert redder Pip fra Orlicks fælde på engene med Startops hjælp.

54.modern-en: Herbert rows beside Pip during the escape attempt; when it fails and Magwitch is caught, Herbert stays steady.
54.modern-da: Herbert ror ved siden af Pip under flugtforsøget; da det mislykkes og Magwitch fanges, forbliver Herbert stabil.

55.modern-en: Herbert invites Pip to come to Cairo and work with him; he leaves for his new life having been saved without ever knowing by whom.
55.modern-da: Herbert inviterer Pip til at komme til Kairo og arbejde med ham; han tager af sted til sit nye liv efter at være blevet reddet uden nogensinde at vide af hvem.

57.modern-en: Herbert's invitation to Cairo awaits Pip; the promise of a new life through friendship is the key to Pip's recovery.
57.modern-da: Herberts invitation til Kairo venter på Pip; løftet om et nyt liv gennem venskab er nøglen til Pips bedring.

58.modern-en: Pip goes to Cairo to work with Herbert; together they build a modest, honest success.
58.modern-da: Pip tager til Kairo for at arbejde med Herbert; sammen opbygger de en beskeden, ærlig succes.

epithet.en: Jaggers' dry, devoted clerk who maintains two utterly separate lives
epithet.da: Jaggers' tørre, hengivne kontormedhjælper der fører to fuldstændig adskilte liv

20.modern-en: Wemmick escorts Pip from Jaggers' office to Barnard's Inn; he is wooden and official in his professional capacity.
20.modern-da: Wemmick eskorterer Pip fra Jaggers' kontor til Barnard's Inn; han er stiv og officiel i sin professionelle egenskab.

21.modern-en: Wemmick shows Pip around London's grimmer quarters with a dry humor that hints at a complex interior life.
21.modern-da: Wemmick viser Pip rundt i Londons mere dystre kvarterer med en tør humor der antyder et komplekst indre liv.

24.modern-en: Wemmick advises Pip in his unofficial Walworth persona: 'Portable property' is the only real wealth in an uncertain world.
24.modern-da: Wemmick råder Pip i sin uofficielle Walworth-persona: 'Bærbar ejendom' er den eneste rigtige rigdom i en usikker verden.

25.modern-en: Wemmick observes Jaggers' dinner party with professional detachment while making small private observations for Pip.
25.modern-da: Wemmick iagttager Jaggers' middagsselskab med professionel distancering mens han giver Pip små private bemærkninger.

26.modern-en: Pip visits Wemmick's eccentric castle home in Walworth; the drawbridge, the cannon, and the tender care of the Aged Parent reveal his whole other self.
26.modern-da: Pip besøger Wemmicks excentriske slotshjem i Walworth; vindbroen, kanonen og den ømme pleje af den Gamle Forælder afslører hans hele anden selv.

32.modern-en: Wemmick guides Pip on a tour of Newgate Prison; in his official capacity he is at home among criminals and cautions.
32.modern-da: Wemmick guider Pip på en tur i Newgate-fængslet; i sin officielle egenskab er han hjemme blandt kriminelle og forsigtighedsregler.

36.modern-en: Wemmick warns Pip not to waste his capital on loans; his practical cynicism comes from years among criminals.
36.modern-da: Wemmick advarer Pip mod at spilde sin kapital på lån; hans praktiske kynisme stammer fra år blandt kriminelle.

37.modern-en: Pip approaches Wemmick in his Walworth persona and secures his help in secretly setting up Herbert's business partnership.
37.modern-da: Pip henvender sig til Wemmick i hans Walworth-persona og sikrer sig hans hjælp til hemmeligt at oprette Herberts forretningskompagniskab.

39.modern-en: Wemmick is urgently consulted after Magwitch arrives; his first official advice is to keep his presence secret at all costs.
39.modern-da: Wemmick konsulteres presserende efter Magwitchs ankomst; hans første officielle råd er at holde hans tilstedeværelse hemmelig for enhver pris.

40.modern-en: Wemmick helps arrange Magwitch's safe temporary hiding and counsels Pip on the legal dangers.
40.modern-da: Wemmick hjælper med at arrangere Magwitchs sikre midlertidige skjulested og vejleder Pip om de juridiske farer.

45.modern-en: Wemmick sends Pip the cryptic warning 'DON'T GO HOME' that saves Magwitch from arrest.
45.modern-da: Wemmick sender Pip den kryptiske advarsel 'GÅ IKKE HJEM' der redder Magwitch fra arrestation.

52.modern-en: Wemmick signals that the time for the escape attempt has come; he is to be married to Miss Skiffins.
52.modern-da: Wemmick signalerer at tiden for flugtforsøget er kommet; han skal giftes med Miss Skiffins.

55.modern-en: Wemmick reveals he has secretly married Miss Skiffins; the Aged Parent attended and fired the cannon in celebration.
55.modern-da: Wemmick afslører at han hemmeligt har giftet sig med Miss Skiffins; den Gamle Forælder deltog og affyrede kanonen til fejring.

epithet.en: The powerful, feared criminal lawyer who controls Pip's fortune
epithet.da: Den magtfulde, frygtede kriminaladvokat der kontrollerer Pips formue

18.modern-en: Jaggers appears at the Three Jolly Bargemen and informs Pip that he has great expectations from an anonymous benefactor and must come to London.
18.modern-da: Jaggers viser sig på Three Jolly Bargemen og informerer Pip om at han har store forventninger fra en anonym velgører og skal komme til London.

19.modern-en: Pip meets briefly with Jaggers to finalize the arrangements for his move to London; Jaggers is efficient and gives nothing away.
19.modern-da: Pip mødes kort med Jaggers for at afslutte arrangementerne for hans flytning til London; Jaggers er effektiv og afslører intet.

20.modern-en: Pip arrives at Jaggers' office in London; the waiting room of desperate clients gives a vivid picture of his power and their fear.
20.modern-da: Pip ankommer til Jaggers' kontor i London; venteværelset med desperate klienter giver et levende billede af hans magt og deres frygt.

21.modern-en: Jaggers is mentioned as the architect of Pip's new life; his presence looms even in his absence.
21.modern-da: Jaggers nævnes som arkitekten bag Pips nye liv; hans tilstedeværelse dominerer selv i hans fravær.

22.modern-en: Herbert tells Pip the story of Jaggers and Miss Havisham — how Jaggers saved Molly from the gallows and placed her daughter with Miss Havisham.
22.modern-da: Herbert fortæller Pip historien om Jaggers og Miss Havisham — hvordan Jaggers reddede Molly fra galgen og placerede hendes datter hos Miss Havisham.

24.modern-en: Jaggers oversees Pip's education and instructs him to spend freely; he refuses to reveal the benefactor's identity.
24.modern-da: Jaggers overvåger Pips uddannelse og instruerer ham til at bruge penge frit; han nægter at afsløre velgørerens identitet.

25.modern-en: Jaggers hosts an extraordinary dinner party; his housekeeper Molly's scarred wrists become a source of unease for Pip.
25.modern-da: Jaggers afholder et ekstraordinært middagsselskab; hans husholderske Mollys arvæv på håndleddene bliver en kilde til ubehag for Pip.

26.modern-en: Jaggers remains the dominant, frightening figure in Pip's London world; even at leisure he cross-examines guests.
26.modern-da: Jaggers forbliver den dominerende, skræmmende figur i Pips Londonverden; selv i fritiden afhører han gæster.

29.modern-en: Jaggers fields Pip's questions about his future and Estella; he gives nothing away and discourages emotional decisions.
29.modern-da: Jaggers besvarer Pips spørgsmål om hans fremtid og Estella; han afslører intet og fraråder emotionelle beslutninger.

30.modern-en: Jaggers summarily dismisses Orlick from Miss Havisham's employ on Pip's complaint.
30.modern-da: Jaggers afskediger summarisk Orlick fra Miss Havishams ansættelse på Pips klage.

36.modern-en: Jaggers pays Pip his annual allowance; he still refuses any details about the benefactor's identity.
36.modern-da: Jaggers betaler Pip hans årlige godtgørelse; han nægter stadig ethvert detalje om velgørerens identitet.

40.modern-en: Jaggers is the legal authority Pip is most afraid of consulting now that the truth about Magwitch is known.
40.modern-da: Jaggers er den juridiske autoritet Pip er mest bange for at konsultere nu da sandheden om Magwitch er kendt.

48.modern-en: Pip presses Jaggers about Molly and Estella; Jaggers allows Wemmick to confirm the connection after Pip reveals what he already knows.
48.modern-da: Pip presser Jaggers om Molly og Estella; Jaggers lader Wemmick bekræfte forbindelsen efter Pip afslører hvad han allerede ved.

51.modern-en: Jaggers makes his extraordinary personal admission: he saved Molly, placed her daughter with Miss Havisham to give the child a better life, and kept the secret for years.
51.modern-da: Jaggers giver sin ekstraordinære personlige indrømmelse: han reddede Molly, placerede hendes datter hos Miss Havisham for at give barnet et bedre liv og bevarede hemmeligheden i årevis.

epithet.en: The sinister journeyman blacksmith, Pip's enemy and Mrs. Joe's attacker
epithet.da: Den uhyggelige daglejersmed, Pips fjende og Mrs. Joes angriber

15.modern-en: Orlick is introduced as Joe's surly journeyman; he picks a fight with Joe and loses; he is present when Mrs. Joe is attacked and is strongly suspected.
15.modern-da: Orlick introduceres som Joes gnarvorne daglejersvend; han udfordrer Joe til slagsmål og taber; han er til stede da Mrs. Joe overfaldes og er stærkt mistænkt.

16.modern-en: Suspicion falls on Orlick for the attack on Mrs. Joe; though not convicted, his guilt is implied.
16.modern-da: Mistanken falder på Orlick for overfaldet på Mrs. Joe; selvom han ikke dømmes, antydes hans skyld.

17.modern-en: Orlick lingers in the background, a sullen resentful presence in Pip's home village.
17.modern-da: Orlick lurer i baggrunden, en dyster og bitter tilstedeværelse i Pips hjemlandsby.

29.modern-en: Pip is alarmed to discover Orlick has been hired as a gatekeeper at Satis House; he knows Orlick cannot be trusted near Miss Havisham.
29.modern-da: Pip forfærdes over at opdage at Orlick er ansat som portvagt ved Satis House; han ved at Orlick ikke kan stoles på i nærheden af Miss Havisham.

30.modern-en: Pip reports Orlick to Jaggers and has him dismissed from Satis House, deepening Orlick's hatred of Pip.
30.modern-da: Pip anmelder Orlick til Jaggers og får ham fyret fra Satis House, hvilket uddyber Orlicks had til Pip.

35.modern-en: Orlick is seen lurking near the forge; his menacing presence remains though he has no direct role in this chapter.
35.modern-da: Orlick ses luske i nærheden af smedjen; hans truende tilstedeværelse forbliver selvom han ikke spiller en direkte rolle i dette kapitel.

43.modern-en: Pip encounters Orlick at a roadside inn and is unsettled by his knowing, malevolent demeanor.
43.modern-da: Pip møder Orlick på et vejkant-værtshus og uroliggøres af hans vidende, ondskabsfulde fremtoning.

53.modern-en: Orlick lures Pip to the sluice house and reveals he attacked Mrs. Joe; he intends to murder Pip, but Herbert and Startop arrive in time to save him.
53.modern-da: Orlick lokker Pip til sluse-huset og afslører at han overfaldt Mrs. Joe; han agter at myrde Pip, men Herbert og Startop ankommer i tide til at redde ham.

57.modern-en: Orlick is mentioned as having broken into Pumblechook's house; he is jailed, removing the threat he posed.
57.modern-da: Orlick nævnes som havende brudt ind i Pumblechooks hus; han fængsles, hvilket fjerner den trussel han udgjorde.

epithet.en: The quiet, sensible village girl who is Pip's true moral compass
epithet.da: Den stille, fornuftige landsbypige der er Pips sande moralske kompas

7.modern-en: Biddy teaches at the village evening school; Pip resolves to learn everything she knows.
7.modern-da: Biddy underviser på landsby-aftenskolen; Pip beslutter sig for at lære alt hvad hun ved.

10.modern-en: Pip seeks Biddy's help with lessons; she is patient and thorough, and clearly more perceptive than he realizes.
10.modern-da: Pip søger Biddys hjælp med lektier; hun er tålmodig og grundig, og tydeligvis mere indsigtsfuld end han indser.

12.modern-en: Biddy is mentioned as part of the village life Pip is increasingly embarrassed by.
12.modern-da: Biddy nævnes som en del af landsbylivet Pip bliver stadig mere flov over.

15.modern-en: Biddy comes to live at the forge to help nurse Mrs. Joe; her quiet competence contrasts with the chaos around her.
15.modern-da: Biddy kommer til at bo på smedjen for at hjælpe med at pleje Mrs. Joe; hendes stille kompetence kontrasterer med kaoset omkring hende.

16.modern-en: Biddy helps decipher Mrs. Joe's attempts to communicate; she suspects Orlick but keeps her counsel.
16.modern-da: Biddy hjælper med at tyde Mrs. Joes forsøg på at kommunikere; hun mistænker Orlick men holder sin mening for sig.

17.modern-en: Pip tells Biddy of his love for Estella and his desire to become a gentleman; Biddy gently asks whether Estella is worth it and whether he'd be happier as he is.
17.modern-da: Pip fortæller Biddy om sin kærlighed til Estella og sit ønske om at blive en gentleman; Biddy spørger forsigtigt om Estella er det værd og om han ville være lykkeligere som han er.

18.modern-en: Biddy listens to the news of Pip's great expectations with quiet sadness.
18.modern-da: Biddy lytter til nyheden om Pips store forventninger med stille tristhed.

19.modern-en: Pip asks Biddy to teach Joe to be more refined; Biddy wisely declines, understanding that Joe is already a better man than Pip.
19.modern-da: Pip beder Biddy om at lære Joe at blive mere forfinet; Biddy afviser klogt og forstår at Joe allerede er et bedre menneske end Pip.

22.modern-en: Biddy is mentioned as the sensible life Pip left behind.
22.modern-da: Biddy nævnes som det fornuftige liv Pip forlod.

27.modern-en: Joe brings news of Biddy and the forge; Pip hears that she is well and thriving.
27.modern-da: Joe bringer nyheder om Biddy og smedjen; Pip hører at hun har det godt og trives.

35.modern-en: Biddy has cared patiently for Mrs. Joe; she shows quiet dignity at the funeral; Pip promises to visit more often and Biddy clearly doubts he will.
35.modern-da: Biddy har plejet Mrs. Joe tålmodigt; hun viser stille værdighed ved begravelsen; Pip lover at besøge oftere og Biddy tvivler tydeligt på at han vil.

57.modern-en: Joe's letters mention Biddy's care and support during Pip's illness.
57.modern-da: Joes breve nævner Biddys omsorg og støtte under Pips sygdom.

58.modern-en: Pip returns to the village intending to propose to Biddy — and finds she has that very day married Joe; he accepts this with genuine joy.
58.modern-da: Pip vender tilbage til landsbyen med intentionen om at bede Biddy om hendes hånd — og finder at hun den dag har giftet sig med Joe; han accepterer dette med oprigtig glæde.

59.modern-en: Biddy and Joe are contentedly settled with their young son; she embodies the simple, honest happiness Pip once overlooked.
59.modern-da: Biddy og Joe er tilfredt etablerede med deres lille søn; hun legemliggør den simple, ærlige lykke Pip engang overså.

epithet.en: Pip's pompous, self-congratulating uncle who claims credit for his rise
epithet.da: Pips pompøse, selvberømmende onkel der tager æren for hans opgang

4.modern-en: Pumblechook attends Christmas dinner and joins in the general persecution of Pip with self-righteous moralizing.
4.modern-da: Pumblechook deltager i julefrokost og slutter sig til den generelle forfølgelse af Pip med selvretfærdig moraliseren.

5.modern-en: Pumblechook flees into the garden when the soldiers arrive, revealing his cowardice.
5.modern-da: Pumblechook flygter ud i haven da soldaterne ankommer og afslører sin fejhed.

6.modern-en: Pumblechook lectures Pip on morality while basking in the reflected importance of their family circle.
6.modern-da: Pumblechook holder foredrag for Pip om moral mens han nyder den reflekterede vigtighed i deres familiekreds.

7.modern-en: Pumblechook has arranged Pip's visit to Miss Havisham and is insufferably pleased with himself for doing so.
7.modern-da: Pumblechook har arrangeret Pips besøg hos Miss Havisham og er utålelig selvtilfreds over at have gjort det.

8.modern-en: Pip stays at Pumblechook's shop before visiting Miss Havisham; Pumblechook drills him with arithmetic at breakfast.
8.modern-da: Pip bor hos Pumblechook inden besøget hos Miss Havisham; Pumblechook eksaminierer ham i regning ved frokosten.

9.modern-en: Pumblechook joins Mrs. Joe in pressing Pip for details about Miss Havisham's household.
9.modern-da: Pumblechook slutter sig til Mrs. Joe i at presse Pip for detaljer om Miss Havishams husstand.

11.modern-en: Pumblechook escorts Pip on his return visit to Satis House, basking in Miss Havisham's reflected glory.
11.modern-da: Pumblechook eskorterer Pip på hans tilbagevendende besøg til Satis House og nyder Miss Havishams reflekterede glans.

12.modern-en: Pumblechook's self-importance grows with each visit; he credits himself with introducing Pip to his benefactress.
12.modern-da: Pumblechooks selvhøjtidelighed vokser med hvert besøg; han tillægger sig selv æren for at have introduceret Pip til hans velgørerinde.

13.modern-en: Pumblechook accompanies the party to Satis House and is fawning toward Miss Havisham; his behavior is transparently self-serving.
13.modern-da: Pumblechook ledsager gruppen til Satis House og er smigrende over for Miss Havisham; hans adfærd er gennemsigtigt egennyttig.

15.modern-en: Pumblechook continues to style himself as Pip's special patron and connection to the great house.
15.modern-da: Pumblechook fortsætter med at betragte sig selv som Pips særlige protektor og forbindelse til det store hus.

18.modern-en: When Pip's great expectations are announced, Pumblechook is delirious with reflected glory and immediately claims credit.
18.modern-da: Da Pips store forventninger annonceres, er Pumblechook delirisk af reflekteret ære og gør straks krav på æren.

19.modern-en: Pumblechook pumps Pip's hand and showers him with congratulations and self-congratulation as he departs for London.
19.modern-da: Pumblechook ryster Pips hånd og oversvømmer ham med lykønskninger og selvlykønskninger da han rejser til London.

28.modern-en: Pip stays at the Blue Boar rather than with Joe; Pumblechook fetes him as a great man.
28.modern-da: Pip bor på Blue Boar frem for hos Joe; Pumblechook fejrer ham som en stor mand.

58.modern-en: When Pip's fortune is gone, Pumblechook is pointedly cold; his fair-weather loyalty is exposed.
58.modern-da: Da Pips formue er væk, er Pumblechook markant kold; hans godvejrsloyalitet afsløres.

epithet.en: The educated swindler who ruined both Magwitch and Miss Havisham
epithet.da: Den uddannede svindler der ødelagde både Magwitch og Miss Havisham

42.modern-en: Magwitch reveals Compeyson as his partner and nemesis — a gentleman swindler who let Magwitch take the heavier sentence while he received lighter punishment.
42.modern-da: Magwitch afslører Compeyson som sin partner og nemesis — en gentlemansvindler der lod Magwitch tage den hårdere dom mens han fik en lettere straf.

43.modern-en: Pip learns that Compeyson is also the man who jilted Miss Havisham on her wedding day — the same villain who destroyed two lives.
43.modern-da: Pip lærer at Compeyson også er manden der forlod Miss Havisham på hendes bryllupsdag — den samme skurk der ødelagde to liv.

45.modern-en: Compeyson is known to be watching Magwitch; his surveillance threatens to expose them all.
45.modern-da: Compeyson vides at overvåge Magwitch; hans overvågning truer med at afsløre dem alle.

46.modern-en: The threat of Compeyson shadows the escape planning; his whereabouts are unknown.
46.modern-da: Truslen fra Compeyson skygger over flugtplanlægningen; hans opholdssted er ukendt.

47.modern-en: Pip spots Compeyson in the theater audience, confirming he is tracking Magwitch's movements.
47.modern-da: Pip opdager Compeyson i teaterpublikummet og bekræfter at han sporer Magwitchs bevægelser.

50.modern-en: Compeyson's role as Magwitch's betrayer and Miss Havisham's seducer is confirmed; he is the common cause of enormous suffering.
50.modern-da: Compeysonss rolle som Magwitchs forræder og Miss Havishams forfører bekræftes; han er den fælles årsag til enorm lidelse.

53.modern-en: Compeyson is part of the net closing around Magwitch as the escape attempt nears.
53.modern-da: Compeyson er en del af nettet der lukker sig om Magwitch da flugtforsøget nærmer sig.

54.modern-en: During the boat chase, Compeyson is drowned in a struggle with Magwitch; the villain's end is violent and anonymous.
54.modern-da: Under bådjagten drukner Compeyson i en kamp med Magwitch; skurkens afslutning er voldsom og anonym.

55.modern-en: Compeyson's death is confirmed; without his testimony, the case against Magwitch is simplified.
55.modern-da: Compeysons død bekræftes; uden hans vidneudsagn forenkles sagen mod Magwitch.

epithet.en: The brutish, wealthy young gentleman who marries Estella
epithet.da: Den brutale, rige unge gentleman der gifter sig med Estella

23.modern-en: Drummle is introduced as a sulky, heavy young man at Mr. Pocket's — unwelcoming and dull.
23.modern-da: Drummle introduceres som en gnaven, tung ung mand hos Mr. Pocket — afvisende og kedelig.

25.modern-en: Jaggers singles out Drummle at dinner with dark approval, calling him 'the spider'; Pip is uneasy.
25.modern-da: Jaggers fremhæver Drummle ved middagen med mørk godkendelse og kalder ham 'edderkoppen'; Pip er utryg.

26.modern-en: Drummle is insolent and unpleasant among the group of lodgers; he and Pip take an instinctive dislike to each other.
26.modern-da: Drummle er fræk og ubehagelig blandt gruppen af logitagere; han og Pip har en instinktiv antipati for hinanden.

27.modern-en: Drummle is mentioned as a shadow over Pip's world, a rival of crude power.
27.modern-da: Drummle nævnes som en skygge over Pips verden, en rival med rå magt.

34.modern-en: Drummle's presence in Estella's circle torments Pip.
34.modern-da: Drummles tilstedeværelse i Estellas kreds plager Pip.

38.modern-en: Drummle flirts with Estella openly in front of Pip; Estella uses him deliberately to wound Pip.
38.modern-da: Drummle flirter åbenlyst med Estella foran Pip; Estella bruger ham bevidst til at såre Pip.

43.modern-en: Pip and Drummle have a tense confrontation at an inn; their mutual contempt is unconcealed.
43.modern-da: Pip og Drummle har en spændt konfrontation på et værtshus; deres gensidige foragt er utildækket.

44.modern-en: Estella tells Pip she is going to marry Drummle; Pip is devastated.
44.modern-da: Estella fortæller Pip at hun skal giftes med Drummle; Pip er knust.

48.modern-en: Drummle has married Estella; rumors of his cruelty to her reach Pip.
48.modern-da: Drummle har giftet sig med Estella; rygter om hans grusomhed mod hende når Pip.

epithet.en: The pompous parish clerk turned failed London actor
epithet.da: Den pompøse sognekontorist der bliver mislykket London-skuespiller

4.modern-en: Wopsle attends the Christmas dinner and delivers theatrical readings of the newspaper with great self-importance.
4.modern-da: Wopsle deltager i julefrokost og fremfører teatralske oplæsninger af avisen med stor selvhøjtidelighed.

5.modern-en: Wopsle joins the search party for the escaped convicts on the marshes.
5.modern-da: Wopsle slutter sig til søgeholdet efter de flygtede forbrydere på engene.

6.modern-en: Wopsle's pomposity is gently satirized as part of the village's self-important adult world.
6.modern-da: Wopsles pompøsitet satiriseres mildt som en del af landsbyens selvhøjtidelige voksenverdenen.

7.modern-en: Wopsle's great-aunt runs the village school where Pip and Biddy study.
7.modern-da: Wopsles grandtante driver landsbyskolens aftenskole hvor Pip og Biddy studerer.

10.modern-en: Pip attends Wopsle's great-aunt's evening school regularly.
10.modern-da: Pip deltager regelmæssigt i Wopsles grandtantes aftenskole.

13.modern-en: Wopsle is part of the village coterie Pip is beginning to outgrow.
13.modern-da: Wopsle er en del af landsbykredsen som Pip begynder at vokse fra.

15.modern-en: Wopsle reads to the group at the pub with dramatic effect; his theatrical pretensions are already visible.
15.modern-da: Wopsle læser for gruppen på kroen med dramatisk effekt; hans teatralske pretentioner er allerede synlige.

16.modern-en: Wopsle is present when the news of Mrs. Joe's attack is spread through the village.
16.modern-da: Wopsle er til stede da nyheden om Mrs. Joes overfald spredes i landsbyen.

17.modern-en: Wopsle maintains his theatrical aspirations as part of the village backdrop.
17.modern-da: Wopsle opretholder sine teatralske ambitioner som en del af landsbybaggrunden.

18.modern-en: Wopsle reads a murder case newspaper account with great drama; Jaggers dismantles his performance with devastating logic.
18.modern-da: Wopsle læser en drabsberetning fra avisen med stor dramatik; Jaggers demonterer hans optræden med ødelæggende logik.

31.modern-en: Wopsle appears as the lead in a disastrous London production of Hamlet; Pip and Herbert are tortured by laughter in the audience.
31.modern-da: Wopsle optræder som hovedrollen i en katastrofal Londonopsætning af Hamlet; Pip og Herbert pines af latter i publikum.

47.modern-en: Pip attends one of Wopsle's later performances; Wopsle tells him afterward that he saw a man from Pip's past sitting behind him — Compeyson.
47.modern-da: Pip overværer en af Wopsles senere forestillinger; Wopsle fortæller ham bagefter at han så en mand fra Pips fortid sidde bag ham — Compeyson.

epithet.en: Jaggers' housekeeper, a wild woman he saved from the gallows — and Estella's mother
epithet.da: Jaggers' husholderske, en vild kvinde han reddede fra galgen — og Estellas mor

26.modern-en: Molly serves at Jaggers' dinner; her scarred wrists and restrained wildness catch Pip's eye and unsettle him.
26.modern-da: Molly serverer ved Jaggers' middag; hendes arvæv på håndleddene og undertrykte vildskab fanger Pips opmærksomhed og uroliggør ham.

48.modern-en: Pip watches Molly and suddenly recognizes her likeness to Estella; he realizes she must be Estella's mother.
48.modern-da: Pip iagttager Molly og genkender pludselig hendes lighed med Estella; han indser at hun må være Estellas mor.

epithet.en: A pleasant fellow lodger of Pip's and Herbert's, who joins the escape attempt
epithet.da: En behagelig medlogierende hos Pip og Herbert der deltager i flugtforsøget

23.modern-en: Startop is introduced as one of the agreeable young men lodging with Mr. Pocket — a contrast to the sullen Drummle.
23.modern-da: Startop introduceres som en af de behagelige unge mænd der bor hos Mr. Pocket — en kontrast til den gnarvorne Drummle.

25.modern-en: Startop attends Jaggers' dinner with Pip and Herbert; he is pleasant and unremarkable.
25.modern-da: Startop deltager i Jaggers' middag med Pip og Herbert; han er behagelig og upåfaldende.

26.modern-en: Startop is part of the group dynamic at the Pocket household.
26.modern-da: Startop er en del af gruppedynamikken i Pocket-husstanden.

34.modern-en: Startop is one of the debating companions in Pip's idle London life.
34.modern-da: Startop er en af diskussionskammeraterne i Pips dovne Londonliv.

52.modern-en: Startop is recruited to help row the boat in the escape attempt; his trustworthiness is valued.
52.modern-da: Startop rekrutteres til at hjælpe med at ro båden i flugtforsøget; hans pålidelighed er værdsat.

53.modern-en: Startop is part of the rescue party that saves Pip from Orlick on the marshes.
53.modern-da: Startop er en del af redningsholdet der redder Pip fra Orlick på engene.

54.modern-en: Startop rows in the escape attempt; he is arrested along with the others when the galley intercepts them.
54.modern-da: Startop ror i flugtforsøget; han arresteres sammen med de andre da galejen opsnapper dem.

epithet.en: Wemmick's nearly deaf but utterly contented old father at the Castle
epithet.da: Wemmicks næsten døve men fuldstændig tilfredse gamle far på Slottet

37.modern-en: The Aged Parent sits contentedly by the fire at Wemmick's Castle; Pip nods at him as instructed and the old man beams with delight.
37.modern-da: Den Gamle Forælder sidder tilfreds ved ilden i Wemmicks Slot; Pip nikker til ham som instrueret og den gamle mand stråler af glæde.

45.modern-en: The Aged Parent is in his usual cheerful state at the Castle, oblivious to the drama unfolding around Pip.
45.modern-da: Den Gamle Forælder er i sin sædvanlige glade tilstand på Slottet, ubevidst om dramaet der udspiller sig omkring Pip.

55.modern-en: The Aged Parent fires the cannon in celebration of Wemmick's secret marriage — his happiest moment in the novel.
55.modern-da: Den Gamle Forælder affyrer kanonen til fejring af Wemmicks hemmelige bryllup — hans lykkeligste øjeblik i romanen.

epithet.en: The merchant who takes Herbert Pocket as a partner thanks to Pip's anonymous funding
epithet.da: Købmanden der tager Herbert Pocket som kompagnon takket være Pips anonyme finansiering

37.modern-en: Pip arranges through Wemmick to invest in Clarriker's shipping firm and secure Herbert a partnership — the best use of his fortune.
37.modern-da: Pip arrangerer via Wemmick at investere i Clarikers rederi og sikre Herbert et kompagniskab — den bedste anvendelse af hans formue.

41.modern-en: Clarriker's firm is the secure foundation Herbert has been promised, though he does not know who funded it.
41.modern-da: Clarikers firma er den sikre grundlag Herbert er lovet, selvom han ikke ved hvem der finansierede det.

45.modern-en: Clarriker's business is flourishing and Herbert is thriving in his role.
45.modern-da: Clarikers forretning blomstrer og Herbert trives i sin rolle.

52.modern-en: Clarriker is completing the last payment arrangements that will establish Herbert permanently.
52.modern-da: Clarriker afslutter de sidste betalingsarrangementer der vil etablere Herbert permanent.

58.modern-en: Pip joins Clarriker's firm and works honestly alongside Herbert; the secret is finally revealed to Herbert.
58.modern-da: Pip slutter sig til Clarikers firma og arbejder ærligt side om side med Herbert; hemmeligheden afsløres endelig for Herbert.
